name: Koyome
taglineZh: 歡迎——就把這裡當成自己的家。
intro:
Koyome here — this is my own small corner of the internet.

I keep the words worth re-reading, the pictures worth looking at twice, and the videos I don't want to forget. Nothing here is finished, and nothing here is in a hurry.

Have a look around — stay as long as you like.
introZh:
我是 Koyome，這裡是我在網路上的一小塊地。

值得重讀的文字、值得多看兩眼的畫面，還有不想忘記的影片，我都放在這裡。這裡的東西都還沒完成，也沒有任何東西在趕路。

隨便逛逛——想待多久都可以。
